Enabling and disabling reporting of security events The BSW module shall provide a configuration switch to enable reporting of security events from the BSW module to the IdsM . The switch shall be located in the General container of the module. Shortname: <ModuleName>EnableSecurityEventReporting Longname: Enable Security Event Reporting The default setting of the switch shall be Off.
